label: Same entrant, called "Shop B"
description: ROADMAP B6. Identical to s2_entrant in every mechanism; the only difference is that the LLM reads the entrant as "Shop B" instead of Starbucks. `hero_agreement` between this and s2_entrant says whether the twins were reacting to the mechanism (hours, price, distance, curiosity) or to the brand name. from_day 1 on the label forces a full rerun rather than a fork, so no day carries the real name.
